# pseudonymizer

> Keyed pseudonymization with HMAC-SHA256 tokens per domain, key ids for rotation and re-identification through a bounded vault port, with a stated threat model Python package `trysac-pseudonymizer`, import name `pseudonymizer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
